manual.catwalks.line2: {0}Catwalks are a more safe structure for the upper floors of a factory, because unlike {1}scaffolding{2}, they can be equipped with railings.
manual.catwalks.line3: When sneaking and using an §2Engineer's Hammer§r on the catwalk, it will add or remove the railing on the respective side.{0}
manual.catwalks.line4: On metal catwalks, the railing can also be colored by using any dye on them.
